name: Emperor Tenji
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 1); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 668–671.

poems.title: Out in the fields this autumn day
poems.author: Emperor Tenji
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 1
poems.text:
Out in the fields this autumn day
They’re busy reaping grain;
I sought for shelter ’neath this roof,
But fear I sought in vain,—
My sleeve is wet with rain.

poems.title: 1. 秋の田の かりほの庵の とまをあらみ (Aki no ta no kariho no io no toma o arami)
poems.author: Emperor Tenji
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後撰集
poems.text:
秋の田の かりほの庵の とまをあらみ
わが衣手は 露にぬれつつ
